title: G7 to release '100 million barrels' of fuel after US pressures EU on fuel crisis
subhead: With fuel prices hitting record highs due to the US-Iran war, the US pressured Europe over the crisis. In response, the G7 countries agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil and agreed to 'refrain from export restrictions on energy.'

title: Fresh alert on contraceptive pill worries French women, but doctors warn against rushed decisions
subhead: France's medicines regulator is warning 1.6 million users of desogestrel-based pills about a risk of meningioma, a usually benign tumor, sparking a surge in calls to doctors.

title: How Jordan Bardella's political youth was shaped by antisemitic ideology
subhead: Accused of writing antisemitic messages when he was a young activist, an allegation he denies, the president of the Rassemblement National came of age politically in a milieu strongly influenced by Alain Soral. An antisemitic polemicist who briefly belonged to the party, Soral remained a popular figure on the French far right throughout the 2010s and, for some, an ideological compass.
